title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 123 Bridgeton Pike in Mullica Hill, New Jersey, as the "James C. 'Billy' Johnson Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 123 Bridgeton Pike in Mullica Hill, New Jersey, as the "James C. 'Billy' Johnson Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a post office in Mullica Hill, New Jersey, after James C. "Billy" Johnson.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 123 Bridgeton Pike in Mullica Hill, New Jersey, as the "James C. 'Billy' Johnson Post Office Building." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
